classic.name: Curse of Agony
classic.text: Curses the target with agony, causing 1044 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

classic.text: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 3200 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players.

classic.name: Create Healthstone (Minor)
classic.text:
Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 100 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

classic.name: Create Soulstone (Minor)
classic.text:
Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 400 health and 700 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Creates a Firestone which can be equipped in the off hand. When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal 40 to 60 additional Fire damage. In addition, equipping the Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by 14.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

classic.text: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

classic.text:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect that lasts 30 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 3% of total Health every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 2% of total Mana every 4 sec.

differences.text: 2 instead of 30, 2 instead of 3, 3 instead of 2, reworded
